headline: GREEK PM 🏛️ BEGS 🥺 Burnham 🍑 For ELGIN 🍇 MARBLES 🗿 PERMANENTLY
text:
GREEK 🇬🇷 PRIME 🧑‍⚖️ MINISTER 🏛️ Kyriakos 🍆 Mitsotakis just DROPPED 📝 a full THIRST 💦 TRAP 🪤 in the Guardian 📰 urging Greater Manchester 🍑 Mayor Andy Burnham 🏙️ to summon the POLITICAL 🗳️ WILL 💪 and send those PARTHENON 🏛️ sculptures back to Athens 🏛️ with ZERO 🛑 strings attached 🧵!! He says it would BLAST 📢 a powerful SIGNAL 📡 of cultural 🍑 friendship but it needs some serious COURAGE 🦁 from Burnham Daddy 🐺 who once promised in 2023 📅 that the marbles 🗿 should return PERMANENTLY 🕳️ no questions asked!! The treasures 🏺 have sat in the British Museum 🏛️ since the 19th century 🕰️ after Lord Elgin 🧔 snatched them from the Ottoman 🕌 rulers and Greece has been SCREAMING 📢 about the dodgy legality ⚖️ ever since. Mitsotakis wrote that nobody in their right mind 🧠 would slice the Bayeux Tapestry 🧵 in HALF ✂️ and call that an adequate VIEW 👀 yet that's EXACTLY 🧐 what happened to the Parthenon marbles 🗿 and it's been edging 😩 this historic dispute for 200 years now!!

Mitsotakis and his government 🏛️ previously tried TALKING 🗣️ with the British Museum 🏛️ crew but those negotiations 🤝 completely FIZZLED 💥 because Greece wants the marbles 🗿 back for GOOD 🏁 not some temporary loan 📅 that forces them to bow 🙇‍♂️ and admit the Brits own their own ancient 🍆 monument!! He straight up ROASTED 🔥 British Museum director Nicholas Cullinan 🧔 for floating the Bayeux Tapestry 🧵 loan as some kind of magical TEMPLATE 📋 for the Elgin deal saying he was genuinely SURPRISED 😲 and that it offers ZERO 🥜 hope because Greece will NEVER 🙅‍♂️ accept any scheme that makes them BORROW 🏦 pieces of their own Parthenon 🏛️ back!! Burnham Daddy 🐺 you told the world in 2023 📅 to return them with no strings attached 🧵 so where's that energy now bro 🧍‍♂️ while the Acropolis Museum 🏛️ sits there with empty slots 🕳️ literally built for these bad boys!!

The Greek PM 📣 used all the recent FANFARE 🎉 around the Bayeux Tapestry 🧵 arriving at the British Museum 🏛️ to crank the rhetoric 📢 and restate the claim that splitting the Parthenon sculptures 🗿 is basically cultural COITUS INTERRUPTUS 😩 and nobody should be cool with half the masterpiece in London 🏙️ and half back home in Athens 🏛️!! He called it a decisive step 🦶 that would transform this bitter 200 year BEEF 🥩 into a unique act of cultural FRIENDSHIP 🤝 and reunite the marbles 🗿 like they were always meant to be!! Back then Burnham 🏙️ supported changing the actual LAW 📜 to make the return happen but last month he suddenly went all "it's ultimately an issue for the British Museum" 🏛️ and legally that's where it rests so Mitsotakis is out here trying to get him to find that missing political WILL 💪 again!!

Those Elgin Marbles 🗿 were carved between 447BC 📜 and 432BC to decorate the Temple of Athena 🏛️ on the Acropolis in Athens and after a 1816 parliamentary committee 🏛️ rubber stamped Lord Elgin's 🧔 removal as legal they got shipped 🛳️ into the British Museum collection by an act of Parliament 📜 itself!! Greeks have always disputed that the Ottoman Empire 🕌 even had the right to let them go and the Parthenon gallery in Athens 🏛️ was deliberately built with gaps 🕳️ waiting for their prodigal statues to come home!! George Osborne 🧔 back when he chaired the museum said he was hunting for a more cooperative ARRANGEMENT 🤝 after years of bitter disagreement but the law still blocks permanent return unless Parliament changes its mind!!

Mitsotakis latest comments 📣 look like a full ramp up in the RHETORIC 🔥 around this thorny issue once more especially after Greece's own health minister 🩺 told Breitbart that maybe Donald Trump 🧑‍🚀 could lean on the Brits to finally cough up the Parthenon pieces 🗿!! The British Museum 🏛️ and UK government keep repeating that the law prevents any permanent handover though loan deals are common AF 📅 yet campaigners keep pointing out the British Museum Act could be amended if anyone actually cared enough to prioritize it!! Burnham Daddy 🐺 in 2023 you were all "no strings attached" 🧵 so Mitsotakis is begging you to stand by those words and make this cultural reunion happen for real this time!!
